headline: HSBC Offloads Troubled $300 Million Data Centre Loan at Steep Discount
summary: HSBC sold a US$300 million troubled loan tied to data centres at a steep discount. The distressed debt sale occurs as global lenders evaluate AI infrastructure debt risks and potential regulatory shifts in the US.
why: HSBC is one of the world's largest banking groups, providing extensive cross-border corporate finance, real estate, and digital infrastructure lending.

impacts.name: HSBC Holdings
impacts.why: Selling the troubled loan crystallizes a discount loss while removing non-performing AI data center debt from the balance sheet.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
